subject: integration
name: Installed integrations standard (INTEGRATION_LIST_0_1)
summary: A definition of INTEGRATION_LIST_0_1: one read group and one function, list, that gives a dashboard a record for each installed integration (id, type, name, origin, codes, state, health). The row has no code, provider or address, and the definition says the browser answers it itself. The group carries the top risk, 10 of 10: whoever holds the grant sees what you installed. The definition cannot check what a page does with the list. Level 4 with privacy because the row runs and connects to nothing. Judged here by its publisher.
